subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Collision contact bookkeeping (per-buffer contact-time/impulse accumulation with overflow normalization and per-slot impact ring buffers), vehicle orientation and wheel/axle physics integration, the timed collision-detection loop and collision network broadcast, plus vehicle-centric UI/audio/debug wiring (tire-compound screen setup, engine-temperature display, vehicle-name message buffer, per-state audio dispatch, and display-node/texture creation).

summary: DERIVED proposal for the vehicle_physics scope. The subsystem is evidenced by the validated IR as several loose groups with mostly unknown owners. (1) Collision contact manager: CollisionContactBufferTimestepUpdate accumulates the timestep into this+0x0, and on overflow past the flt_59E43C threshold normalizes the this+0x4/this+0x8 impulse accumulators into the this+0xC/this+0x10 outputs and resets all three; CollisionContactSolver consumes per-slot accumulated floats and global counters at this+0x4/this+0x8, recording impacts into per-slot ring buffers and clamping penetration against dbl_8AFEA0/flt_7D108C. (2) Vehicle state integration: VehicleOrientationFromAngularVelocityIntegration integrates angular velocity doubles at this+0xD8/0xE0/0xE8 from axis-input doubles at this+0x138/0x140/0x148 and a second scaled vector at this+0x150/0x158/0x160, then extracts Euler angles from a rotation matrix and forwards to sub_54B4D0; PhysicsIntegrationStep_e620 clamps the fixed timestep from dbl_8AFE98 and runs a semi-implicit Euler suspension integration gated on terrain sampling. (3) Session-gated collision orchestration: RunCollisionDetectionLoop runs a QPC-timed loop gated on this+0x3FC4==3, CollisionEventNetworkBroadcast sends a COM-buffer progress-bar event when the session-state field is 1 or 2, CollisionSpatialQuery invokes a vtable method at 0x6C on the sub-object at obj+0x3FB8 and arms retry state. (4) Vehicle array iteration: CollisionContactIteration walks the 104-slot array (base 0x005EC6D8, stride 0x48C0) and toggles AI control/driver visibility by penetration ratio. (5) Vehicle UI/audio/debug: tire-compound screen setup, engine-temperature display, vehicle-name message buffer, nationality matcher, per-state audio dispatch, and display-node/texture creation. Owners beyond a small set of GUESS classes are deliberately left UnknownObject; all fields, callees, and globals are reported verbatim from the packet, and no evidence reference is invented.

function_roles.role: Thin caller: loads the global double dbl_8AFE90 into a local, forwards it with the this object into sub_4537B0 (return discarded), then returns the char result of ShortComputation_5bd0; suggested as a per-frame or state-triggered update broadcast by its named callers.

Integrates vehicle angular velocity over an elapsed time step into orientation: guard on this+0xD0, delta against timestamp this+0x24, accumulates scaled axis inputs (this+0x138/0x140/0x148) onto angular-velocity doubles (this+0xD8/0xE0/0xE8), computes a second scaled vector (this+0x150/0x158/0x160), post-processes it via sub_56C020, extracts Euler angles (gimbal-lock branch on dbl_59E420 vs general branch) from a rotation matrix, and forwards body-state to sub_54B4D0; returns the guard value when the guard is clear.

Scales a collision penalty value: dereferences the float threshold array from this+0x0, finds its boundary via FloatArrayThresholdSearch, clamps a2 upward to that boundary, then returns a2 scaled by 0.035 (flt_59F078) as a double.

Advances a collision contact buffer by timestep a2: accumulates into contact-time this+0x0; when it exceeds flt_59E43C, normalizes impulse accumulators this+0x4/this+0x8 by the reciprocal into outputs this+0xC/this+0x10 and resets all three; then a 104-iteration loop adds a2 to each contact-pair timer entry; returns a pointer past the timer block.

Processes a single collision contact selected by the low byte of the first a2 dword: for slot index below 0x68 reads the per-slot accumulated float this[v4+109] and clears this[v4+5]; on exceedance of 0.5 records an impact (marker this[v4+1097]=-1082130432, ring-buffer short via FloatToShortViaFtol, counters at this+v4+852 and ring offsets at this+v4+956), corrects v3[1] via ShortArrayLookupAndZeroCheck, clamps v3[1] into [dbl_8AFEA0 - flt_7D108C, dbl_8AFEA0]; unconditionally accumulates this[1]+=v11 and increments this[2], returning the counter.

Per-axle physics integration for one wheel slot: clamps the fixed timestep from dbl_8AFE98 to a maximum of 0.033333335 (negative to 0.0), resolves wheel state arrays (base a1+112544, 56-byte stride) from the a3 wheel index, computes the wheel velocity delta, scales it by the inverse timestep via Vector3ScalarMultiply, samples terrain height/roughness via TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling, and when the contact gate passes integrates suspension velocity/displacement semi-implicitly under clamping; writes the velocity back to a3 and the wheel state; a fallback stores current values without integrating.
Writes the multiplicative inverse of a2 (1.0/a2) into the float field at this+0x4; called by SessionTypeSetter.

Runs a timed collision-detection loop gated on session phase this+0x3FC4==3: initializes a QPC timer, loops while AnimationValueFetchWithTiming yields values (refreshing animation timing via AnimationTimingUpdateWithParamSet on this+0x3FB8 with a 4.0 budget), accumulating the high-resolution timer delta until the 60.0-second timeout (EmptyStub_0170, return 0); on completion processes the value via sub_4F9FC0, converts with TimerConversionWithSin, places the multiplayer vehicle via MultiplayerVehiclePlacement, resets the collision array via ArrayInitializationLoop, and returns 1.

Iterates the 104-slot vehicle array (base unk_5EC6D8, stride 0x48C0, ending at byte_7C54D8) and for each vehicle whose live-state int32 at +0x32C8 equals 2 computes a penetration ratio (per-vehicle float at a1+0x1A3D4 divided by flt_7D108C) and consults ShortArrayLookupAndZeroCheck; on severe contact (ratio>2.0 or contact flag) releases AI control via VehicleAIControlFlag(0) and toggles driver visibility (hidden when ratio>8.0 or |contact|>0.75, else shown); otherwise retains AI control via VehicleAIControlFlag(1) and shows the driver.

Broadcasts a collision event over the network when the owning-object state at +0x3FC4 is 1 or 2: reads session time dbl_8AFEA0, encodes a progress-bar event via ProgressBarEventEncode, obtains a buffer from the COM object at +0x3FB8 via COMVTableCallVia0x60, sets the flag byte at buffer+4 to 1, dispatches through NetworkSendDispatch, and releases the buffer via VirtualMethodDispatch; returns the send-success flag.

Issues a spatial/collision query on the sub-object stored at obj+0x3FB8 (obj = *(this+0)) by invoking its vtable method at offset 0x6c via VTableCallViaOffset0x6c with a2/a3; returns 0 when the call returns non-zero; on success arms retry state (byte obj+41=1, float obj+16=5.0, dword obj+16324=4) and returns 1.

Post-initialization pass after a vehicle scene load: resets field 0x124 to the -1.0f sentinel bit pattern, calls CUBESceneLoaderEntry() and FieldSetterCall(2), runs update helpers sub_466350 and sub_466650 on this, then conditionally calls sub_541CA0(1) when the flag at field 0xEC is non-zero; always returns 0.

Conditional debug display updater: when the type selector at this+0x304 equals 435 and the session-state check on dword_7CD25C passes, seeds a local path buffer from byte_5EA438, composes a debug string via sub_4B0B20/StringFormatWrapper, and calls BoundedFieldSetter(159 - strlen) to update a bounded field.

Unconditional UI screen-setup for tire compound selection: stores race mode dword_7D0410 into this+0x324, binds the tire compound data pointer dword_7CFFCC into this+0x320, fetches the indexed list entry via UIListIndexedAccessor, formats it via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, clamps the compound config byte_7CE498 via TireCompoundClamp, updates the edit buffer via EditBufferStringUpdate; returns 0.

Reads the current vehicle name via VehicleNameAccessor(dword_7CD25C), validates it against the string table (byte_5EC4C0/byte_5EC4CC), copies it into the message buffer byte_5EC4CC, and drives the UI text update via UIStringComparison; falls back to the default path string byte_5EA438 when the name is null or empty; returns 0 on both paths.

Iterates season entries in SeasonScoringDB (dword_7D2E48, stride 18624, sub-offset 18196) matching each against all vehicle files, calling NationalityDriverInfoLoader(0) when all vehicle files match a season or when a season has no vehicle files; guarded on VehicleArray (dword_8AC394) being non-null and VehicleCount (dword_5C329C) / VehicleFileCount (dword_8AC390) positive.

Advances a collision/animation timer accumulator at this+0x318; returns -1 early when ByteFieldGetterAt100 reports a block flag or the enable byte at this+0x304 is zero; otherwise adds the external float at this+0x40 onto the accumulator, dampens it toward 0.75, converts via CRTFtol, and when ShortComputation_6720 returns a positive count dispatches that many calls through a __stdcall function pointer at receiver offset 184 with the boolean (result==4); returns 0 on completion.

Frees a global collision-geometry linked list: first walks it with StringCompareLinkedListSearch on each node's data pointer (node+0), advancing via next pointers (node+4); then walks again freeing every node with FreeWrapper_7bcf, additionally freeing the data payload (EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf) when the ownership byte at node+8 is non-zero and data is non-null; finally zeroes dword_7CDDF0/7CDDF4/7CDDF8/7CDDFC; returns early when the list head is null.
Unconditional collision/physics parameter setter: stores the global double dbl_8AFE90 into the float field at this+0xC0 on every call; no guards, no callees.

Collision response-type classifier: accumulates FloatFieldAccessor into a running float at byte offset 200, then selects a small integer response code (1..13) from flag checks on dword fields at byte offsets 100/104/108/112 and companion flags at 132/136/140; some branches overwrite the offset-200 accumulator with 0 or the literal 1059481191; the offset-112 field yields 12/13 when set.

Formats a vehicle debug string: copies asc_5CCE54 into the caller buffer, selects a vehicle struct either by a sub_4D1B50 index lookup into the array base unk_5EC6D8 or directly from dword_7C54E0 (guarded by bit 0 of byte_7CFFF0), and when the selected pointer is non-null and a float field at offset 16552 (indexed by a value at dword_7C54E0+16448) is greater than 0.0, formats a string from offset 18168 via off_5C3730/StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and outputs it through sub_589901; returns 0 on every path.

Builds a candidate vehicle file path (filter path, source at ConditionalDispatch result +32, an extension of dword_5CCEBC plus byte_5CCEC0, and a season directory), registers it via StringRegistry, searches a linked list for a matching node, writes it into *a2, reads dimensions from a chained object, creates a vehicle display node (VehicleNodeCreation), renders a 2D rectangle, creates an audio sound handle, computes scaled rectangle values, and stores parameters a6/a7 into this+0x14/this+0x18; temporary lists are cleaned up with PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval; entire body is guarded by dword_8AFE88/ValueGetter.

Per-state audio dispatch for a vehicle: reads seven audio-source handles from this[12]..this[18] and, depending on collision check (sub_49B9A0), two state reads (sub_49BA30), the fuel check (sub_49BA50), the disqualification/pit checks (sub_49BAB0/sub_49BA90), and two flag checks (sub_49BAD0/sub_49BB20), triggers AudioEffectTrigger or fires a random collision event via RandomCollisionEvent; returns the final AudioEffectTrigger result.

Allocates a 96-byte node via the Nh-malloc wrapper, zero-fills it, and stores the pointer at this+0x8; sets flag bit 0 at node+68, then attempts D3D texture creation with (a2, 0, 2052); on success the node is cleaned up (EmptyStub_7470) and freed (FreeWrapper_7bcf) and this+0x8 is cleared; on failure the node pointer is retained in this+0x8 for retry; returns this+0x8.

classes.name: CollisionContactManager
classes.responsibility: Holds the shared collision-contact bookkeeping state: accumulated contact time at +0x0, two impulse accumulators at +0x4/+0x8 normalized into outputs at +0xC/+0x10 on overflow, and the global contact counter pair at +0x4/+0x8 consumed by the per-slot solver. Class identity is GUESS; field access is evidenced across both methods.

classes.name: VehicleOrientationIntegrator
classes.responsibility: Vehicle body-orientation state integrated by VehicleOrientationFromAngularVelocityIntegration: a stored timestamp at +0x24, an enable/guard slot at +0xD0, angular-velocity doubles at +0xD8/+0xE0/+0xE8, axis-input doubles at +0x138/+0x140/+0x148 and a second scaled rotation-vector triple at +0x150/+0x158/+0x160. Class identity is GUESS; each field is evidenced by the integration.

classes.name: SessionCollisionController
classes.responsibility: Session-gated collision orchestration object: a session-phase int at +0x3FC4 (==3 runs the timed collision loop, 1/2 allow network broadcast, 4 armed as retry state), a parameter/COM sub-object pointer at +0x3FB8, a state byte at +0x29 and a timeout float at +0x10 for the armed retry. Class identity is GUESS; the fields are evidenced on the obj base by the two sub-object-reaching functions.

classes.name: VehicleUiScreenState
classes.responsibility: Vehicle-facing UI screen state shared by the temperature-display, tire-compound, and animation-timer updaters: a type/enable selector at +0x304, a timer accumulator at +0x318, bound data pointer at +0x320, race-mode value at +0x324, and an external float source at +0x40. Class identity is GUESS; each field is evidenced at the this base by one or more of the three methods.

classes.name: VehicleDisplayNodeFactory
classes.responsibility: Creates and manages a vehicle display/texture node: this+0x8 holds the node slot (stored, retained for retry, or cleared on texture-creation success), this+0x14 and this+0x18 receive caller-supplied parameters during node creation. VehicleNodeCreateWithAudioVisual calls the node creator (0x0049E930). Class identity is GUESS; fields are evidenced per base.

interfaces.name: NetworkCollisionDispatchInterface
interfaces.purpose: Encodes and dispatches a collision event over the network: obtains a COM-owned buffer from the object at +0x3FB8 via COMVTableCallVia0x60, dispatches through NetworkSendDispatch, and releases via VirtualMethodDispatch.

interfaces.name: CollisionQueryInterface
interfaces.purpose: Spatial/collision query invoked on the sub-object at obj+0x3FB8 through its vtable method at offset 0x6C, with retry state armed on success.

interfaces.name: VehicleArrayInterface
interfaces.purpose: Iteration over the 104-slot vehicle array (base 0x005EC6D8, stride 0x48C0, bound 0x007C54D8) filtered by the live-state int32 at +0x32C8, used for per-vehicle collision-contact response and debug-string formatting.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle array contract: base 0x005EC6D8, 104 slots at stride 0x48C0 (18624 bytes) ending at 0x007C54D8; per-slot live-state int32 at +0x32C8 equal to 2 selects collision-contact response; per-vehicle penetration float at a1+0x1A3D4.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionContactBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-buffer collision contact layout: accumulated contact time at +0x0, two impulse accumulators at +0x4/+0x8, normalized outputs at +0xC/+0x10, overflow normalization against the flt_59E43C threshold, and a 104-entry contact-pair timer block (two floats per pair) advanced each step.

compatibility_contracts.name: ContactSlotRingBufferLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-slot contact-ring layout in the collision solver: slot index cap 0x68, per-slot accumulated float at this[v4+109] cleared on impact, impact threshold 0.5, impact marker this[v4+1097], short ring buffer via this[8*v4+265] advanced by the ring byte at this+v4+956 (mod 0xF), impact counter at this+v4+852 (cap 0x10), and penetration clamp into [dbl_8AFEA0 - flt_7D108C, dbl_8AFEA0].

compatibility_contracts.name: FixedTimestepPhysicsBehavior
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-axle integration timestep contract: the fixed timestep from dbl_8AFE98 is clamped to a maximum of 0.033333335 (one thirtieth) and negative values to 0.0; integration is gated on terrain sampling succeeding, the sampled height exceeding dword_7D1158, and the penetration limit flt_7D108C minus dword_7D1158 being positive; wheel slots are 56-byte state records at base a1+112544.

compatibility_contracts.name: OrientationIntegrationLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Vehicle orientation state layout used by the integrator: guard at +0xD0, stored float timestamp at +0x24, angular-velocity doubles at +0xD8/+0xE0/+0xE8, axis-input doubles at +0x138/+0x140/+0x148, second scaled rotation-vector doubles at +0x150/+0x158/+0x160, and a 72-byte rotation matrix copied from offset 240 for Euler extraction (gimbal-lock sentinels at 0x0059E420/0x0059E430); body state forwarded to sub_54B4D0.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionPhaseGateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Session-phase gating on the +0x3FC4 field: value 3 runs the timed collision-detection loop, values 1 or 2 permit the collision network broadcast, and a write of 4 arms spatial-query retry state together with state byte at +0x29 and timeout float at +0x10; the parameter/COM sub-object lives at +0x3FB8.

unresolved: The concrete owning classes of most functions are unknown; owners were left as UnknownObject rather than guessed. Only CollisionContactManager, VehicleOrientationIntegrator, SessionCollisionController, VehicleUiScreenState, and VehicleDisplayNodeFactory carry GUESS identities based on shared field bases or caller/callee links.

In CollisionContactManager, the +0x4/+0x8 fields are both impulse accumulators (0x45C7E0) and global contact counters (0x45C8F0); the packet does not prove these two 'this' pointers alias the same object, so the shared-field reading is DERIVED inference, not confirmed ownership.

SessionCollisionController's session-phase field is accessed as this+0x3FC4 by 0x45F390 and as obj+0x3FC4 (obj=*(this+0)) by 0x462940/0x462CE0; equal offsets on different bases are not proven to be the same field.
ShortComputation_5bd0 (callee of 0x455E50) appears only in raw source text with no packet callee evidence reference; its identity and signature rest on the source alone.
The semantics of sub_4537B0, sub_56C020, sub_54B4D0, and whether sub_54B4D0 writes orientation back to the same object, are not established by this packet.
The 1.0/0.0 constants at dbl_59E420/dbl_59E430 are interpreted as gimbal-lock sentinels by reconstruction, not by direct evidence.
The rotation matrix copied from offset 240 has no packet field evidence ref; it is treated as part of the object's rotation state.
The exact layout of the 56-byte wheel slot and the two axle state arrays (base a1+112544) in PhysicsIntegrationStep_e620 is not defined by the packet.

In CollisionContactSolver the dynamic-indexed state arrays (per-slot floats at this[v4+109], impact markers at this[v4+1097], counters at this+v4+852, ring buffers at this[8*v4+265], ring offsets at this+v4+956) are not packet fields; the meaning of the 0x68 slot count and the -1082130432 literal are not established.
The numeric value of the flt_59E43C overflow threshold is not present in the packet.
The value fetched by AnimationValueFetchWithTiming (v7/v8/v9 triple) and its 4.0 budget / 60.0 timeout units are taken from call order only; why this+0x3FC4 must equal 3 is unresolved.
The collision array reset target this+26864 in RunCollisionDetectionLoop has no named counterpart in the packet.

CollisionEventNetworkBroadcast's a2 collision-event structure, the packet buffer layout, the purpose of the flag byte at buffer+4, and whether VirtualMethodDispatch releases or re-uses the buffer are unconfirmed.
The identity and purpose of the vtable method at offset 0x6C on the sub-object at obj+0x3FB8 are unknown.
The meaning of the flag at field 0xEC gating sub_541CA0(1) in VehicleScenePostInit is not established.
In EngineTemperatureDebugDisplay the type-selector value 435 and the semantics of BoundedFieldSetter's argument are not documented.
How UIListIndexedAccessor selects its index and how dword_7CFFCC relates to the tire compound list are not visible in TireCompoundScreenSetup.
In VehicleNameToMessageBuffer, whether the strcpy guarded by the string-table search is duplicate-suppression or an index update is not visible in the raw source.
The exact return convention of sub_588410 (match vs mismatch) is inferred from its call sites; the semantics of the 18196 sub-offset within each SeasonScoringDB row are not defined.
The indirect __stdcall target loaded from receiver offset 184 in CollisionAnimationTimerUpdate is unknown; no static callers are recorded.
Global flt_59E450 is listed in the packet for several functions but does not appear in their raw bodies; its role is unknown.
CollisionGeometryFreeList globals 0x007CDDF4 and 0x007CDDFC are only written (zeroed) here; their wider roles are unresolved.

CollisionResponseTypeClassification's mapping of returned codes (1..13) to collision response types is unconfirmed; the decompiler shows v1 (ecx) uninitialized, so the v1+offset accesses are treated as this-object accesses without independent verification.
In FormatVehicleDebugString the identity of the float field at offset 16552 and the string at offset 18168 is only DERIVED from the fill; argument a2 is unused.
In VehicleNodeCreateWithAudioVisual the a6/a7 parameters stored at this+0x14/+0x18 and the v21/v22 scaled values are unidentified; whether sub_588410 is a file-existence check is GUESS.
